visual.summary: Fire pit level 1: a stone hearth with a cooking spit, three log benches and a lamp post; no longer sunk, and the fire stays unlit.
problems: Level 1 is bare round the edges (no plants); the log benches are pale stripped birch that doesn't match the dark timber of the other buildings: spruce or oak logs.
Level 3 only adds red carpets on the benches and a few plants over level 2: give it its own feature (a cooking pot on a tripod, a woodpile shelter).

visual.summary: Dark spruce log benches round a stone fire ring with an unlit campfire and a spit, a woodpile, a stump and a lamp post. Better colours; the ground round it is still bare grass with stray stones.
problems: The lone cobblestone blocks in front of the ring and beside the bench look like stray blocks: join them into a short stepping path to the fire, or use gravel or coarse dirt patches round the ring instead
Round the edges it is still bare: a few ferns, short grass or a bush behind the benches
